description:
Intent i016 (firmware-table-divisor, snapshot s03) complete. Four findings reported in /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C1/agent-state/findings/i016.json, all with literal source quotes verified in the reported ranges:

1. s03 drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nvkm/subdev/volt/gk104.c:52-66 (medium confidence, quote "div = 27648000 / bios->pwm_freq;"). Untrusted source: nvbios_volt_parse (bios/volt.c:110-111) fills pwm_freq = nvbios_rd32(volt+0x5)/1000 and pwm_range = nvbios_rd32(volt+0x16) as raw VBIOS u32 reads with no validation. Violated invariant: the parse-time /1000 truncates any VBIOS value 1..999 to 0, so a nonzero firmware input becomes a zero divisor at gk104_volt_set line 59, exactly like the seed's 8*speed wrap; line 60 additionally divides DIV_ROUND_UP((uv - bios->base) * div, bios->pwm_range) by the equally unvalidated pwm_range. Unsafe use: plain u32 '/' during voltage programming on GK104+ PWM-mode boards -> divide-by-zero oops. Counterevidence checked: gk104_volt_new only gates on parse success and PWM type/GPIO, no clamp; sibling fanpwm.c:67 does zero-guard its own pwm_freq use.

2. s03 drivers/gpu/drm/radeon/radeon_atombios.c:3694-3718 (medium confidence, quote "((nominal_voltage - min_voltage) / voltage_step) *"). voltage_step is copied verbatim (or (step+1)/2) from the ATOM BIOS VoltageObjectInfo formula; the only check (line 3705) validates fetch success, not the value; line 3714 divides by it with no zero guard. Sole caller rv6xx_step_sw_voltage also uses the same unvalidated step as the while-loop increment (rv6xx_dpm.c:1294-1295), adding an infinite-loop consequence.

3. s03 drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/legacy-dpm/si_dpm.c:6509-6516 (medium confidence, quote "slope1 = (u16)((50 + ((16 * duty100 * pwm_diff1) / t_diff1)) / 100);"). t_diff1 = t_med - t_min where t_min/t_med/t_high are raw le16 VBIOS ATOM_PPLIB fan-table fields (legacy_dpm.c:243-248) with no ordering/zero validation; usTMed==usTMin yields divisor 0, usTMed<usTMin wraps the u32 subtraction to ~2^32. Identical unchecked instances at radeon/si_dpm.c:5999-6000 (source r600_dpm.c:894-896) and radeon/ci_dpm.c:960-961; contrast: ci_populate_fuzzy_fan (ci_dpm.c:341-345) does zero-check fan_output_sensitivity, showing the gap is real.

4. s03 drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nvkm/subdev/volt/gk104.c:38-49 (low confidence, quote "return bios->base + bios->pwm_range * duty / div;"). gk104_volt_get divides by nvkm_rd32(0x20340) with no nonzero check; divisor is a hardware register, so confidence is low.

Additional classifications: smu7_thermal.c:280 left unresolved (firmware u8-derived RPM limits gate the user speed; fanless table rejects all speed>0, blocking the wrap); r600_dpm.c:227 safe (fl==0/fh==0/fl>fh explicitly rejected at line 224, closing the divisor the s04 sibling intent left unresolved); amdgpu/atom.c:694 and :712 safe (atom_op_div/div32 guard src != 0); nouveau fanpwm.c:71 safe (pwm_freq guarded nonzero at line 67). Limitations: bounded search (ACPI/SMBIOS/EDID/DT/EEPROM only pattern-scanned, not line-audited); no runtime reproduction on real hardware; gk104 .volt_set call graph and isl28022.c:441 gain provenance not traced.
